satisfies.instructions: Does the artifact fully satisfy the supplied spec?

criteria.true: All required behavior is present and consistent with the spec.
criteria.false: At least one required behavior is missing or contradicted.

overreaches.instructions: Does the artifact add unsupported behavior beyond the supplied spec?

criteria.true: It adds behavior not supported or requested by the spec.
criteria.false: It stays within the supported/requested scope.

quality.instructions: Rate readiness against the supplied spec.
